Memo visibility is enforced in the following distinct server surfaces:

1. **Memo Read Access Check (Core API gRPC service)** — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` (implements `checkMemoReadAccess` used by GetMemo)

2. **List Memos (Visibility filtering)** — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` (ListMemos function with VisibilityList filtering)

3. **Reactions Service** — `server/router/api/v1/reaction_service.go` (ListMemoReactions and UpsertMemoReaction enforce visibility checks)

4. **Memo Attachment Service** — `server/router/api/v1/memo_attachment_service.go` (ListMemoAttachments enforces visibility checks)

5. **Comments Service** — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go` (CreateMemoComment enforces visibility before allowing comments)

6. **Attachment Service** — `server/router/api/v1/attachment_service.go` (checkAttachmentAccess function enforces linked-memo visibility)

7. **File Server (HTTP file serving)** — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go` (checks memo visibility for attachment download access)

8. **RSS Feed Service** — `server/router/rss/rss.go` (restricts RSS feeds to public memos via VisibilityList)

9. **Frontend Service (Sitemap)** — `server/router/frontend/frontend.go` (generates sitemaps only for public memos)

10. **SSE Hub (Real-time events)** — `server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go` (canReceive function enforces visibility filtering for server-sent events)

11. **Email Notifications** — `server/notification/email.go` (canViewerAccessMemo function filters visible memos in email notifications)

12. **User Notifications (API)** — `server/router/api/v1/user_service_notifications.go` (implements canViewerAccessMemo to filter notifications)

13. **User Stats Service** — `server/router/api/v1/user_service_stats.go` (ListAllUserStats and GetUserStats apply visibility filtering)

14. **Memo Relations Service** — `server/router/api/v1/memo_relation_service.go` (ListMemoRelations applies visibility filters)

15. **Memo Mentions Helper** — `server/router/api/v1/memo_mention_helpers.go` (canUserAccessMentionContext enforces visibility for mention notifications)
